data_quality_concerns: The input file is not properly parsed; all 8 distinct logical columns are currently concatenated into a single comma-delimited string column per row due to unquoted commas embedded within the Address field.
Addresses contain embedded commas (e.g., 'North Jane, MH 48812') which will break standard CSV parsing unless proper escaping or regex-based extraction is applied.
Phone numbers vary widely in formatting (e.g., dashes, parentheses, dots, and extensions like 'x06431'), requiring standardization during ingestion.
